headline: Bolivia Annual Inflation Reaches 7.08% as October Prices Jump
summary: Bolivia's consumer prices rose 2.07% in October, more than double September's pace, bringing yearly inflation to 7.08% according to the national statistics institute.
why: Consumer price inflation figures are key indicators for central banks and investors evaluating macroeconomic stability, monetary policy trajectories, and purchasing power within an economy.

impacts.name: Bolivia
impacts.why: Higher inflation erodes domestic purchasing power and creates pressure on monetary policy.
